# Transloadit Media Processing

Curated by Skill Harbor — turns Transloadit's cloud media infrastructure into plain-language workflows: encode video to HLS/MP4, generate thumbnails, resize and watermark images, OCR documents, extract or transcode audio, concatenate clips, and chain multi-step pipelines with 86+ processing robots, via an MCP server or CLI. Discovered via skills.sh. Collected in the github/awesome-copilot repository, listed here with credit to its source. Honest caveats: requires a free Transloadit account (API credentials — heavy jobs consume credits, so check pricing for your volume); your files are uploaded to Transloadit's cloud, so keep sensitive media out. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
